Chapter 479: Chapter 16: The Battle of Ascension (Please Subscribe)_3

“When did such a strong being appear in this era?” the Lingxu Immortal King’s expression shifted slightly.

He was constantly vigilant about the battlefield, watching the fight between Lin Yuan and the emaciated Immortal King. He vaguely felt that Lin Yuan’s strength probably surpassed that of the Open Heaven Immortal King and the Supreme Immortal King.

“This won’t do, the balance has been broken.”

“The Martial Ancestor cannot be allowed to remain.”

The Lingxu Immortal King made up his mind.

He had not anticipated that this ascension battle would add someone as exceptional as the Martial Ancestor. Such strength, yet it was the first time he was participating in the ascension battle – it was inconceivable.

...

Under these circumstances, in the ensuing war, no one would be able to withstand the Martial Ancestor, and the situation would likely turn disadvantageous for them.

“I must make a move.”

“At the very least, I must heavily injure the Martial Ancestor.”

The Lingxu Immortal King looked towards Lin Yuan.

At this moment, several Supreme Immortal Kings from the Prehistoric Era joined forces, attempting to block the Martial Ancestor.

But with Lin Yuan’s casual movements, those Supreme Immortal Kings were clearly unable to hold on for long.

Hu…

The Lingxu Immortal King still stood there.

But his True Body was hidden deep in the void, approaching Lin Yuan.

As the strongest presence in the field, the Supreme Immortal King, the Lingxu Immortal King believed that with his methods, a stealth attack would gravely injure, if not kill, the Martial Ancestor.

“You are too weak.”

“Too weak, and the Power of Creation you control is also quite ordinary.”

Lin Yuan looked at the several Supreme Immortal Kings surrounding him; with each strike he dealt, their aura would weaken significantly.

Just then.

A dusky shadow loomed over Lin Yuan from above.

“Destruction…”

The Lingxu Immortal King raised his right hand, and a dusky aura enveloped Lin Yuan.

An advanced Power of Creation.

The Great Destructive Force.

This was a killing Power of Creation that ranked alongside the force to open the heavens.

The difference between the two is that the force to open the heavens attacks a single point or a line.

Whereas the Great Destructive Force attacks an area.

Massive and overpowering, all in front of it will be annihilated.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted slightly.

This kind of Great Destructive Force was indeed the bane of energy, spirit, and life.

“Disperse!”

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred slightly.

He wanted to disperse his Primordial Spirit Body.

But immediately after, a binding force bore down upon him.

“I have cultivated the Great Destructive Force to the Third Realm, and six other ordinary Powers of Creation to the Third Realm as well.”

“The combined strength of six Third Realm ordinary Powers of Creation is almost not weaker than a Third Realm advanced Power of Creation.”

“It’s akin to me wielding two Third Realm advanced Powers of Creation.”

The Lingxu Immortal King was very confident in himself. Even the Open Heaven Immortal King could only defend when facing him.

By lowering himself to make a stealth attack on this Martial Ancestor, he might even be able to shatter his physical body and completely rob him of the ability to continue fighting.

…

“No good, the Martial Ancestor…” The Open Heaven Immortal King, who was far away, also noticed this scene and instantly became anxious. He slashed out several times in quick succession, trying to restrain the Lingxu Immortal King.

But he was immediately entangled by the opponent in front of him.

The Supreme Immortal King was the same, his Immeasurable Force vast and boundless, but alas, he was desperately blocked by two peer Supreme Immortal Kings.

Rustle…

Lin Yuan’s brows were tightly knitted.

Under the restraint of six types of Third Realm Powers of Creation, it was difficult for him to move in a short time, and he could only resist the pouring Great Destructive Force.

Hum.

The terrifying Great Destructive Force descended, quickly causing Lin Yuan’s Primordial Spirit Body to collapse and eventually be forcefully reduced to nothingness.

“Hmm?”

“This easily?”

The Lingxu Immortal King was somewhat surprised; he thought that the Martial Ancestor’s spirit might be able to escape.

“The Martial Ancestor!!!” The Open Heaven Immortal King roared in rage. He could never have imagined that the Martial Ancestor would die. In the ascension battle, the fall of a Supreme Immortal King was an extremely rare event.

“Despicable Lingxu Immortal King,” the Supreme Immortal King’s gaze was icy as he stared at the Lingxu Immortal King.

He had seen the Lingxu Immortal King’s stealth attack from the shadows with his own eyes.

“Hmph.”

The Lingxu Immortal King let out a cold snort, unconcerned.

Suddenly.

Just then.

The Lingxu Immortal King seemed to sense something and his expression changed slightly.

“What is that?”

The Lingxu Immortal King looked down, toward the Sixth Layer Heaven, The Fifth Heaven, Fourth Heaven…

Within his perception, he faintly detected dull and trembling sounds from the lower heavens, as if some colossal being was continually trampling on various marvels and phenomena, and, at an inconceivable speed,

was piercing through one heaven after another, heading towards the Seventh Layer of Heaven.

The Lingxu Immortal King could almost imagine that the myriad suppressions and restrictions of the Nine Heavens were almost as fragile as tissue paper in front of this colossal being.

Even the barriers between the heavens were effortlessly torn apart by it.

Boom!

The next moment.

The ground of Seventh Layer of Heaven collapsed, and a figure exuding boundless vital energy appeared above the Lingxu Immortal King, looking down from a great height with indifference.

The oppression that felt like the heavens collapsing almost made the Lingxu Immortal King suffocate; he nearly knelt down.
